Transparent counters and clear gaps, not a solid rectangle. Clean flat filled smooth artwork on truly transparent background, no gradients, grain, speckles, texture, shadow, glow or additional marks. Preserve exact original geometry and proportions with generous transparent outer padding. Independent preview identity, not dealer approved.
